content: Do not barter your precious gems for glass beads; invest your attention in that which never perishes.
author: Kabir
explanation: Attention is the most precious currency of consciousness. Spending it on trivial arguments and fleeting vanity is throwing gold into the gutter.
practicalInsight: Track your screen time and mental energy today. Reclaim two hours for nourishing reading or meditation.
reflectionPrompt: What trivial glass beads am I buying with the priceless gold of my attention?
originalQuote: Do not barter thy precious gems for glass beads; invest thy attention in that which never perishes.
